examples.english: It is important to learn from history.

notes:
{歴史|れきし} means history—either the academic study of the past or the background/record of something.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {歴史|れきし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: to have a long history
- {歴史|れきし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to go down in history
- {歴史|れきし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振り返|ふりかえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on history

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧: historical
- ⟦{歴史家|れきしか}→歴史家：noentry⟧: historian
- ⟦{日本史|にほんし}→日本史：noentry⟧: Japanese history
- ⟦{世界史|せかいし}→世界史：noentry⟧: world history
- ⟦{歴史書|れきししょ}→歴史書：noentry⟧: history book

「{歴|れき}」 AS SUFFIX:
{歴|れき} alone means "record" in compounds:
- ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧: work history
- ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧: educational background
- ⟦{病歴|びょうれき}→病歴：19429_byoureki⟧: medical history
